|lore=Corellian pilot. Defected from the Empire shortly after graduation from the Academy. Tech communications officer at Echo Base. Relays orders to nearby Rebel starships.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During your deploy phase, if present with a scomp link, may deploy a battleground system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If at Echo Command Center, may use 1 Force to suspend ‘Hoth Energy Shield Rules’ until start of your next turn.

|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Romas "Lock" Navander (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “[Pilot] 2. When present with a scomp link, once during each of your deploy phases, you may ▼ one battleground system. While at Echo Command Center, may use 1 Force to suspend "Hoth Energy Shield Rules" until the start of your next turn.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During your deploy phase, if present with a scomp link, may deploy a battleground system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If at Echo Command Center, may use 1 Force to suspend ‘Hoth Energy Shield Rules’ until start of your next turn.” '''What changed:''' “[Pilot] 2. When” → “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During your deploy phase, if”; “once during each of your” → “may”; “phases, you may ▼ one” → “a”; “system. While” → “system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If”; “"Hoth” → “‘Hoth”; “Rules"” → “Rules’”; removed “the”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153629/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards4.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 3, slip 17. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Romas 'Lock' Navander]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth#Cards|Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
